featured.name: Madeleine Opoc
featured.text:
Dr. Parth Bhavsar provided one of the best healthcare experiences I have ever had. He is caring, professional, attentive, and truly takes the time to listen and understand his patients’ needs. Throughout the visit, he was patient, compassionate, and made me feel heard and respected.

What impressed me most was how helpful and accommodating he was, ensuring that all of my concerns were addressed thoroughly. I never imagined that a telehealth appointment could deliver such a high-quality, personalized experience. Dr. Bhavsar exceeded my expectations and demonstrated that excellent patient care can be provided even through a virtual visit.

I highly recommend Dr. Parth Bhavsar to anyone looking for a knowledgeable, understanding, and dedicated physician.

featured.name: Jim W.
featured.text:
The best medical consultation that I’ve had in my entire life. Dr. Bhavsar was very thorough, had excellent bedside manners & was a subject matter expert re. my issue. He diagnosed my issue within minutes and wrote a script on Memorial Day at a nearby 24x7 pharmacy & problem solved.

If you have the opportunity to schedule a consult, trust me, you’ll be happy that you did!
